VI.description: Returns the caption of the window hWnd through user32.dll GetWindowTextW (stdcall\2C called in any thread) as UTF-16 code units\2C so a caption in any language survives (narrowing it to LabVIEW bytes would not). The buffer is nMaxCount code units of zeros\2C and the caption is cut at its terminating 0. For a window of LabVIEW's own process the function sends WM_GETTEXT\2C which LabVIEW answers also while a dialog's modal loop runs (measured on LabVIEW 2025). return value is the number of characters copied\2C 0 for an empty caption or on failure. When error in carries an error the DLL is not called. Generated by scripts\5CBuild Win32 Wrappers.vi - do not edit by hand\2C rebuild it.

Control.description: Size of the buffer in UTF-16 code units\2C including the terminating 0. Longer captions are cut.
When this carries an error the DLL is not called and the error is passed to error out.

Indicator.description: The caption as UTF-16 code units\2C without the terminating 0.
Number of characters copied\2C not counting the terminating 0\3B 0 for no caption or on failure.
error in\2C or the Call Library Function Node's own error.
